ability.name: Step 0 - Machine Context Check
ability.description: Natively determines machine details, domain registration, parsed privileges, and checks running processes/services for known AV/EDR agents to satisfy OPSEC constraints.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\\Windows\\Temp\\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $current_user = whoami; $privs = @(); whoami /priv /fo csv | ConvertFrom-Csv | ForEach-Object { if ($_.PrivilegeName) { $privs += $_.PrivilegeName } }; $privs_json = $privs | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; $cs = Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem; $part_of_domain = if ($cs.PartOfDomain) { "true" } else { "false" }; $domain_name = $cs.Domain; $av_edr = @(); try { $avs = Get-WmiObject -Namespace root\SecurityCenter2 -Class AntiVirusProduct -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($avs) { $avs | ForEach-Object { $av_edr += $_.displayName } } } catch {}; $services = Get-Service -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "defender|crowdstrike|carbon|sentinel|cylance|cortex|sysmon" }; if ($services) { $services | ForEach-Object { $av_edr += $_.Name } }; $processes = Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "defender|crowdstrike|carbon|sentinel|cylance|cortex|sysmon" }; if ($processes) { $processes | ForEach-Object { $av_edr += $_.Name } }; $av_edr_json = ($av_edr | Sort-Object -Unique) | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; $adapters = Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' -and $_.PrefixLength -lt 32 } | ForEach-Object { $b = ([System.Net.IPAddress]$_.IPAddress).GetAddressBytes(); $mk = [System.BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]([Math]::Pow(2,32)-[Math]::Pow(2,32-$_.PrefixLength))); if ([BitConverter]::IsLittleEndian) { [Array]::Reverse($mk) }; $net = (0..3|ForEach-Object{$b[$_]-band $mk[$_]}) -join '.'; "$net/$($_.PrefixLength)" }; $adapters_json = ($adapters | Sort-Object -Unique) | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output "PLATFORM: windows"; Write-Output "HOSTNAME: $env:COMPUTERNAME"; Write-Output "CURRENT_USER: $current_user"; Write-Output "DOMAIN_JOINED: $part_of_domain"; Write-Output "DOMAIN_NAME: $domain_name"; Write-Output "TOKEN_PRIVILEGES: $privs_json"; Write-Output "AV_EDR: $av_edr_json"; Write-Output "NETWORK_CIDRS: $adapters_json"; ($adapters | Sort-Object -Unique) | Out-File "$d\network_cidrs.txt" -Encoding ascii } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: step0 failed - $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\step0.txt

rationale: Performs initial local profiling and parses security state programmatically.
